reports.entrypoints_and_invariants: Reviewed all production loaders/resolvers and existing tests. Actual app loaders use hard-pinned manifests; path separators and missing entries reject before file reads; reads/decompression are bounded, per-sheet LRU is 64. Catalog sorting/nonoverlap/capacity, protobuf grid multiplication and byte-list length, nonzero pattern factors, displacement/effect phase caps, sprite/BMP offsets and exact pixel lengths were checked. World region table validates header/identity/order/contiguous offsets before payload slicing, bounds zstd sectors and shared tile/item budgets, rejects bad palette indices, and verifies placement digest. Offline/live callers bound per-tile draws and fall back to builtin visuals on failure. Raw public helpers accept values outside production preconditions, but pinned production artifacts and caller guards prevent the considered malformed catalog/offset hypotheses. Python verified actual manifest/index pins, catalog SHA, 6249 unique safe manifest names, 5084 nonoverlapping sprite ranges. No new demonstrated finding; this does not qualify the native LZMA/BMP decoder at runtime.
